svg.title: A Finder window walking through projects, focus and toolbox
svg.desc: A macOS Tahoe Finder window in list view. The sidebar selection moves from projects to focus to toolbox every 4 seconds and the listing follows it. projects holds convert.in, qr.in, snipsearch, stelegraphy. certifications holds aws-cloud-genai.pdf, azure-genai.pdf, backend-javascript.pdf, javascript-dasar.pdf, microsoft-fabric.pdf, python-dasar.pdf. awards holds technotainment-uiux.pdf, iofest-webdev.pdf, lks-cybersecurity.pdf, ibfest-cyberlite.pdf, samsung-ai.pdf, ehax-ctf.pdf, jhic-infra.pdf.
